summary: Terex Corporation filed a Form 8-K on July 31, 2026, voluntarily providing financial statements of REV Group, Inc. (acquired February 2, 2026) and pro forma combined statements. This is a supplementary disclosure to the prior acquisition, not a new special situation. The filing incorporates by reference REV's unaudited condensed financials and Terex's pro forma results for regulatory and registration statement purposes. No new transaction, terms, or recommendation are included. The filing is routine follow-up to the completed merger, so it does not represent a current special-situation event.
